title: Impact Map Schema
description: Maps source-path globs to the test groups a change to them affects, so the Agent Pack runs review and test on the blast radius only. One canonical format so the Portal can read coverage-per-change instead of each project inventing its own (nine did).

always_run.description: Cheap smoke that runs on EVERY change regardless of diff — the last line against a regression the map missed.

groups.description: Named test groups. A changed file matching a group's sources pulls in that group's tests.

sources.description: Path globs; a changed file matching one belongs to this group.

tests.description: Unit test files/ids to run when this group is affected.

it.description: Integration/smoke/e2e cases for this group (coverage can't trace these, so they are declared).

risk.description: Advisory risk of this area; high-risk groups may force wider testing.

fallback.description: What to run when a changed file matches NO group. 'ALL' (the safe default) forces the full suite — under-scoping silently is the one failure that makes selective testing unsafe.
